recipes.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all Zombie cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
{1}{B}: Regenerate this creature.

mechanism.clause: When this creature enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all Zombie cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

recipe_coverage: Whole-Oracle fixed-window entry subtype card selection; actual types, ordinary costs, both controllers and real reentry/replay. Human/Soldier/Zombie/Kavu/Elf/Merfolk card predicates include independently pinned implemented noncreature Kindred/Changeling positives; Island includes a nonbasic Island and excludes non-Island lands. Exact selected quantity, optional decline where printed, partial/empty/duplicate/outside-window controls, legal library remainder order and zone/card conservation. All printed nonentry clauses remain explicit gaps.
